messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — we need to send a proactive update to 6 high-touch accounts affected by this morning's embeddings ingestion slowdown. Draft below, looking for ⚡ fast review (legal + technical). pinging @kevin_success_mgr @liz_product @jordan_se

kevin_success_mgr: Thanks. Can we include an explicit line about one-time SLA credit and how that will appear on billing? customers ask for clarity. :cash_with_wings:

liz_product: Agree. Also offer a short complimentary enablement session — helps reduce churn risk while we investigate root cause. Keep wording concise. :white_check_mark:

jordan_se: Technical note: mitigation deployed at 12:32 UTC — we routed affected tenants to a warm dedicated pool with slightly higher p99 latency. This restored throughput but increases per-token latency by ~15-20% for some workloads.

jordan_se: Lightweight command we used to flip routing (share for CS if they get technical questions):
```
# enable tenant fallback routing to dedicated pool
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/enable-fallback -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","fallback":"dedicated_pool"}'
```

nick_onboarding: Can we attach an invite link for a 30-min 1:1 troubleshooting + enablement session? I'll own scheduling. Suggest two slots: Tue 09:00-11:00 PT, Wed 13:00-15:00 PT.

maria_cs: Draft message to customers (will send from cs@redwood):
"Hi <CustomerName>,

We’re reaching out with an update regarding a brief degradation in embeddings ingestion that started at ~12:10 UTC today. Our engineers detected increased queueing on the shared ingestion path and routed affected tenants to a warm dedicated pool to restore throughput. While this fixed ingestion backlog, you may see slightly higher latency for some requests.

What we’re doing:
- Applied a regional routing fallback to dedicated capacity to restore throughput (done).
- Running a targeted ingest retry and backfill to catch up queued items (in progress).
- Investigating root cause; we’ll share an RCA within 72 hours.

Compensation: We will apply a one-time operational credit equal to the pro-rated cost impact for the period of degraded ingestion; your CS rep will follow up with details.

Offer: We’d also like to offer a complimentary 30-minute enablement session to review ingest best practices and tune batch/kv-cache settings specific to your workload — sign up here: <calendar-link>.

If you see any regression or need immediate assistance, reply to this email or open a support ticket and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks for your patience,
The Redwood Customer Success Team"

kevin_success_mgr: Nice. Two edits: 1) swap "operational credit" -> "billing credit" for clarity; 2) add expected RCA delivery window as "within 72 hours" (you already have that).

liz_product: Also add a short FAQ line: "Will this change affect data residency? No — routing stays within your configured region." Helps calm compliance-sensitive customers.

ops_lead: Confirming the dedicated pool fallback is safe for all 6 tenants — we've validated KV cache compatibility. No data loss risk. :shield:

maria_cs: Updated draft applied. Final check: legal sign-off? @kevin_success_mgr can you confirm the credit phrasing is OK to send?

kevin_success_mgr: Yup approved. Confirmed wording: "We will apply a one-time billing credit to offset measurable impact during the affected period."

srebot: Incident 1765128000 — Embedded ingestion throughput degraded. Mitigation: regional fallback active. Status: monitoring.

maria_cs: Great. I'll send to the 6 accounts now and include the calendar link for the enablement session. Nick will own scheduling follow-ups.

nick_onboarding: Got it — I'll DM each contact after the email goes out and post the meeting notes in shared drive.

liz_product: Recommend capturing a short survey at the end of each enablement to collect feedback for product improvements. I'll draft the 3-question form.

maria_cs: Perfect — assign tasks:
- maria_cs: send customer emails (now)
- nick_onboarding: schedule enablement sessions + follow-up (ASAP)
- jordan_se/ops_lead: continue RCA, share timeline
- liz_product: produce 3-question feedback form
- kevin_success_mgr: confirm final customer credit entries with finance

maria_cs: Sending now. Will post a brief status update here when responses start coming in. :rocket:
